z-rcher-oberland-t-sstal-hulftegg.title: Zürcher Oberland · Tösstal · Hulftegg
z-rcher-oberland-t-sstal-hulftegg.slogan: A 112 km loop out of Pfäffikersee warm-up
z-rcher-oberland-t-sstal-hulftegg.story: The local curve pantry when the Alps are too much. A 112 km loop that starts and ends near Pfäffikon, about 2 h 07 of riding. It goes by way of Bauma Tösstal entry, Ricken ridge road and Rapperswil. The climb of the day is Hulftegg passlet. It tops out at 954 m. The passes are the reason to go.

sections.advice: Bauma Tösstal entry → Hulftegg passlet is the reward section in Hulftegg passlet. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
sections.photoQuery: Bauma Tösstal entry Hulftegg passlet Hulftegg passlet

sections.advice: This Hulftegg passlet → Ricken ridge road stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.
sections.photoQuery: Hulftegg passlet Ricken ridge road Hulftegg passlet

sections.advice: Use Ricken ridge road → Rapperswil food return as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

scenicChapters.title: Bauma Tösstal entry → Hulftegg passlet
scenicChapters.narrative: 13 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

scenicChapters.title: Rapperswil food return → back to Pfäffikersee warm-up
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 26 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

z-rcher-oberland-t-sstal-hulftegg.storyWas: The local curve pantry when the Alps are too much.
